INTRODUCTIONWhat is Wireshark?• Free and open-source network protocol analyzer used to capture and inspect network packets.• Used for network troubleshooting, education, application testing, and defensive cybersecurity.• Main interface: Packet List → Packet Details → Packet Bytes.• Helps make network communication visible so users can understand what is happening between devices.GROUP 3 • INFORMATION ASSURANCE & SECURITY02

CAPABILITIESKey features & security usesLIVE CAPTURECapture authorized network traffic in real time.FILTERINGFocus on specific protocols, addresses, ports, or fields.PROTOCOL ANALYSISInspect Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, DNS, ICMP, TLS, andmore.DEFENSIVE ANALYSISInvestigate connection problems and unusual trafficbehavior.GROUP 3 • INFORMATION ASSURANCE & SECURITY03
